newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania upper house of Senate adopted the bill on civil status.
* Parliament's lower Chamber of Deputies resumed debates on the penal code bill.
* Hungarian Democratic Union presidential candidate Gyorgy Frunda submitted his bid for the November 3 pools with the Central Electoral Bureau.
* President Ion Iliescu is visiting western Timis county.
* Romanian Foreign Minister Theodor Melescanu met his Mozambique counterpart. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
